feeds.title: AllAfrica » Construction
feeds.description: Stay updated on the construction industry of Africa with us. AllAfrica is a voice of, by, and about Africa - aggregating, producing, and distributing news and information from over 140 African news organizations and our reporters to an African and global public. AllAfrica's multi-channel platform is the only independent, comprehensive pan-African news source, with unrivaled reach and reputation.

feeds.title: Creamer Media's Engineering News » Construction
feeds.description: Get the latest news on the construction sector, including construction materials, infrastructure, property development, and green building. Creamer Media was founded by Martin Creamer in 1981, with the first tabloid edition of Engineering News published on 13 March 1981. Engineering News Online provides real time news reportage through originated written, video, and audio material.

feeds.title: CCE Online News
feeds.description: cceonlinenews.com is an online portal that offers the latest news and first-hand information on projects in the construction industry in Africa as well as emerging trends and innovations in the industry. We strive to ensure that the information we publish is accurate, balanced, and credible.

feeds.title: Infrastructure News » Construction
feeds.description: Infrastructure News brings together the communities from our three magazines - IMIESA, Water&Sanitation Africa, and ReSource. It's a leading industry news hub, with in-depth articles, interviews and videos, an events calendar, and full social media functionality. Check out the website for construction news.

feeds.title: MiTek South Africa
feeds.description: MiTek is a comprehensive provider of integrated building solutions. Our software, services, engineered products, and automation enable you to transform the way you design, make, and build. We collaborate to share knowledge and empower breakthroughs in building and construction. We engineer holistic, technology-enabled solutions that integrate entities across the supply chain.

feeds.title: KH Plant Blog
feeds.description: KH Plant is South Africa's premier specialist motor grader rebuild center. Our motor graders are built by expert technicians, who combine state-of-the-art technology with the craftsman's touch and meticulous attention to detail. Our blog provides useful tips and information on motor graders and other construction-related topics.

feeds.title: Motheo Construction Group Blog
feeds.description: The late Dr. Thandi Ndlovu established the Motheo construction group in 1997. We are the leading provider of Social Housing in the country, but we are far more than a housing company. Having branched out into general building, civil construction, water-saving technologies, and electrical works, as well as having established a fully-fledged academy, Motheo is a formidable force in the construction industry.

feeds.title: Africa Surveyors » Construction
feeds.description: Read articles, news, and more on construction. Africa Surveyors is Africa's premier source of Surveying, Mapping, and Geospatial news and an envoy of surveying products/services for the Construction, Maritime, Onshore & Offshore energy and exploration, Engineering, Oil and Gas, Agricultural and Mining sectors on new solutions based trends and technology for the African market.

feeds.title: CAPE Business News » Building, Construction, Infrastructure & Development
feeds.description: Find all the latest Building, Construction, Infrastructure & Development news, and stay up to date with what's happening today. Cape Business News, established in 1980, as an A3 Tabloid-style newspaper to provide insightful monthly editorial content on the economic growth, development, and business opportunities predominantly in and around the Western Cape, the publication has a National distribution, reaching those who have an invested interest in the Cape Region.

feeds.title: Construction Review » Africa
feeds.description: Explore the African construction industry. Group Africa Publishing Limited is a media house with an international character extending throughout the globe. The company produces and maintains constructionreviewonline.com and its associated social media channels as well as a print magazine. The company focuses on meeting the information and marketing needs of the construction and mining sector through seminars, exhibitions, and the publication of targeted magazines and websites.

feeds.title: Africa Construction Law Blog
feeds.description: Africa Construction Law (ACL) is a pan-African initiative set up by construction law practitioners across Africa and in the diaspora to promote thought leadership in the field of construction law and practice in Africa. Here you will find links to articles and technical papers on trends and developments in the field of construction law.
